title: "Mordor Industrial Policy Summit — venue changed"

Due to the Barad-dûr Convention Centre becoming unavailable for structural reasons (the structure is no longer available), the Third Mordor Industrial Policy Summit will now be held in Minas Tirith.

**Programme changes:**

- The panel *"Scaling Heavy Industry with a Single Charismatic Founder"* proceeds as scheduled, with a revised risk-management discussant.
- *"Winning Hearts and Minds Through Mass Surveillance: An Eye-Level View"* is cancelled.
- A new session has been added: *"Post-conflict Reconstruction and the Repricing of Volcanic Real Estate."*

Refunds for delegates who registered under duress will be processed within one Age.
